race.comment: FORGOTTEN SPIRIT (11) returned from a 19-week spell in outstanding fashion last start, caught right on the line in an open three-year-old race over 1000m at Eagle Farm three weeks ago. Down in grade in a race that has been heavily depleted by scratchings. The small niggle is the final 100m but in a field that lacks depth she should get away with this. STARLIGHTNING (5) scored on debut at the Gold Coast then lacked the turn of foot required when unplaced over 1000m at the Sunny Coast last start. Deserves another chance over the extra 200m today. STARVECCHIO (12) can improve second-up after a long break. Started in the red when resuming over 1000m at the Sunshine Coast but missed the placings. The extra 200m is a big help. Lightly raced five-year-old mare TAM NA GHAR (13) returns from a 23-week spell. Debuted last prep with a placing over this trip at the Sunshine Coast. Two recent trials will have her up to the mark. Last start debut winner KINKI FISH (3) cannot be underestimated.
